 'archiver',(SELECT json_build_object('archived_count',archived_count,'last_archived_wal',last_archived_wal,'last_archived_time',last_archived_time,'failed_count',failed_count,'last_failed_wal',last_failed_wal,'last_failed_time',last_failed_time,'stats_reset',stats_reset) FROM pg_stat_archiver)

set +e
PGDATA="$(psql -X -A -t -d postgres -U postgres -c 'show data_directory' 2>/dev/null | head -1)"
printf 'PGDATA=%s\n' "$PGDATA"
printf 'CONFIG_FILE='; psql -X -A -t -d postgres -U postgres -c 'show config_file' 2>/dev/null | head -1
printf 'RECOVERY_SIGNAL_FILES\n'
for f in "$PGDATA/standby.signal" "$PGDATA/recovery.signal" "$PGDATA/postgresql.auto.conf"; do if [ -e "$f" ]; then stat -c '%n\t%s\t%y\t%F' "$f"; else printf 'MISSING\t%s\n' "$f"; fi; done
printf 'WAL_LINKS\n'
find -L "$PGDATA" -maxdepth 2 -type d -name pg_wal -print 2>/dev/null
WAL="$PGDATA/pg_wal"; [ -d "$WAL" ] || WAL="$(find -L "$PGDATA" -maxdepth 2 -type d -name pg_wal -print -quit 2>/dev/null)"
printf 'WALDIR=%s\n' "$WAL"
if [ -n "$WAL" ] && [ -d "$WAL" ]; then
  printf 'WAL_SEGMENTS\n'; find "$WAL" -maxdepth 1 -type f \( -name '[0-9A-F]*' -o -name '*.history' \) -printf '%f\t%s\t%TY-%Tm-%TdT%TH:%TM:%TS%TZ\n' 2>/dev/null | sort
  printf 'ARCHIVE_STATUS\n'; find "$WAL/archive_status" -maxdepth 1 -type f -printf '%f\t%s\t%TY-%Tm-%TdT%TH:%TM:%TS%TZ\n' 2>/dev/null | sort
  printf 'WAL_DIR_LISTING\n'; ls -la --time-style=full-iso "$WAL" 2>/dev/null
fi
printf 'PARTITIONS\n'; cat /proc/partitions 2>/dev/null
printf 'MOUNTS\n'; df -PT "$PGDATA" "$WAL" 2>/dev/null
printf 'AUTO_CONF_REDACTED\n'
if [ -f "$PGDATA/postgresql.auto.conf" ]; then
  awk 'BEGIN{IGNORECASE=1} /^[[:space:]]*(restore_command|archive_command)[[:space:]]*=/ {sub(/=.*/,"= [configured; value redacted]"); print; next} /^[[:space:]]*(archive_mode|archive_library|archive_timeout|primary_slot_name|recovery_target|recovery_target_lsn|recovery_target_time|recovery_target_xid|recovery_target_name|recovery_target_action|wal_level|wal_sender_timeout|wal_receiver_timeout|synchronous_commit|synchronous_standby_names|full_page_writes|recovery_prefetch)[[:space:]]*=/ {print}' "$PGDATA/postgresql.auto.conf"
fi
printf 'END\n'
if [ -d /controller/log ]; then tar -czf - -C /controller log; else tar -czf - --files-from /dev/null; fi
